mn22:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn22:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Ariṭṭhassa nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti:
mn22:2.2: Tathā 'haṃ Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye 'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā Bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
mn22:2.4: Ariṭṭhassa kira nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
mn22:2.5: Tathā 'haṃ Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye 'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā Bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
mn22:3.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yena Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mn22:3.2: Saccaṃ kira te āvuso Ariṭṭha evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
mn22:3.4: Evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā . . . antarāyāyāti.
mn22:3.5: Atha kho te bhikkhū Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetukāmā samanuyuñjanti samanugāhanti samanubhāsanti:
mn22:3.6: Mā evaṃ āvuso Ariṭṭha avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
mn22:3.7: Anekapariyāyena h' āvuso Ariṭṭha antarāyikā dhammā vuttā Bhagavatā, alañ-ca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
mn22:3.8: Appassādā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo;
mn22:3.18: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti.
mn22:3.19: Evam-pi kho Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tehi bhikkhūhi samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno tad-eva pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharati:
mn22:3.20: Evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā . . . antarāyāyāti.
mn22:3.21: Yato kho te bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ atha yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mn22:3.22: Ariṭṭhassa nāma bhante bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
mn22:3.25: Ariṭṭhassa kira nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
mn22:3.27: Atha kho mayaṃ bhante yena Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo ten' upasaṅkamimha, upasaṅkamitvā Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etad-avocumha:
mn22:3.28: Saccaṃ kira te āvuso Ariṭṭha evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
mn22:3.30: Evaṃ vutte bhante Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo amhe etad-avoca:
mn22:3.31: Evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā . . . antarāyāyāti.
mn22:3.32: Atha kho mayaṃ bhante Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetukāmā samanuyuñjimha samanugāhimha samanubhāsimha:
mn22:3.33: Mā evaṃ āvuso Ariṭṭha avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
mn22:3.34: Anekapariyāyena h' āvuso Ariṭṭha antarāyikā dhammā vuttā Bhagavatā, alañ-ca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
mn22:3.35: Appassādā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo;
mn22:3.37: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti.
mn22:3.38: Evam-pi kho bhante Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo amhehi samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno tad-eva pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharati:
mn22:3.39: Evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā . . . antarāyāyāti.
mn22:4.1: Yato kho mayaṃ bhante nāsakkhimha Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ atha mayaṃ etam-atthaṃ Bhagavato ārocemāti.
mn22:5.1: Atha kho Bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
mn22:5.2: Ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ āmantehi:
mn22:5.4: Evam-bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato paṭissutvā yena Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etadavoca:
mn22:5.6: Evam-āvuso ti kho Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ Bhagavā etad-avoca:
mn22:5.7: Saccaṃ kira te Ariṭṭha evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
mn22:5.9: Evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā . . . antarāyāyāti. --
mn22:6.1: Kassa kho nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mayā evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi.
mn22:6.2: Nanu māyā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena antarāyikā dhammā vuttā, alañ-ca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
mn22:6.3: Appassādā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo;
mn22:6.13: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
mn22:6.14: Atha ca pana tvaṃ moghapurisa attanā duggahītena amhe c' eva abbhācikkhasi attānañ-ca khanasi bahuñ-ca apuññaṃ pasavasi.
mn22:6.15: Taṃ hi te moghapurisa bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
mn22:7.3: Api nāyaṃ Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo usmīkato pi imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ti. -- Kiṃ
mn22:7.6: Evaṃ vutte Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.
mn22:7.7: Atha kho Bhagavā Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhānaṃ viditvā Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etad-avoca:
mn22:7.8: Paññāyissasi kho tvaṃ moghapurisa etena sakena pāpakena diṭṭhigatena,
mn22:8.2: Tumhe pi me bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha yathā 'yaṃ Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo attanā duggahītena amhe c' eva abbhācikkhati attānañ-ca khanati bahuñ-ca apuññaṃ pasavatīti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ --
mn22:8.4: anekapariyāyena hi no bhante antarāyikā dhammā vuttā Bhagavatā,
mn22:8.6: Appassādā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo,
mn22:8.8: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti. --
mn22:8.9: Sādhu bhikkhave, sādhu kho me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha.
mn22:8.10: Anekapariyāyena hi vo bhikkhave antarāyikā dhammā vuttā mayā, alañ-ca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
mn22:8.11: Appassādā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo,
mn22:8.13: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
mn22:8.14: Atha ca panāyaṃ Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo attanā duggahītena amhe c' eva abbhācikkhati attānañ-ca khanati bahuñ-ca apuññaṃ pasavati,
mn22:8.15: taṃ hi tassa moghapurisassa bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
mn22:9.1: So vata bhikkhave aññatr' eva kāmehi aññatra kāmasaññāya aññatra kāmavitakkehi kāme paṭisevissatīti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn22:10.1: Idha bhikkhave ekacce moghapurisā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti,
mn22:10.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ;
mn22:10.3: te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ paññāya atthaṃ na upaparikkhanti,
mn22:10.4: tesaṃ te dhammā paññāya atthaṃ anupaparikkhataṃ na nijjhānaṃ khamanti,
mn22:10.5: te upārambhānisaṃsā c' eva dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti itivādappamokkhānisaṃsā ca,
mn22:10.6: yassa c' atthāya dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tañ-c' assa atthaṃ nānubhonti,
mn22:10.7: tesaṃ te dhammā duggahītā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti,
mn22:10.10: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave puriso alagaddatthiko alagaddagavesī alagaddapariyesanaṃ caramāno,
mn22:10.12: tam-enaṃ bhoge vā naṅguṭṭhe vā gaṇheyya,
mn22:10.13: tassa so alagaddo paṭiparivattitvā hatthe vā bāhāya vā aññatarasmiṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅge ḍaseyya,
mn22:10.14: so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn22:10.17: evameva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacce moghapurisā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti . . .
mn22:11.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacce kulaputtā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti,
mn22:11.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ,
mn22:11.3: te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkhanti,
mn22:11.4: tesaṃ te dhammā paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkhataṃ nijjhānaṃ khamanti,
mn22:11.5: te na c' eva upārambhānisaṃsā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti na itivādappamokkhānisaṃsā,
mn22:11.6: yassa c' atthāya dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tañ-c' assa atthaṃ anubhonti,
mn22:11.7: tesaṃ te dhammā suggahītā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti,
mn22:11.10: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave puriso alagaddatthiko alagaddagavesī alagaddapariyesanaṃ caramāno,
mn22:11.13: ajapadena daṇḍena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā gīvāya suggahītaṃ gaṇheyya;
mn22:11.14: kiñcāpi so bhikkhave alagaddo tassa purisassa hatthaṃ vā bāhaṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ bhogehi paliveṭheyya, atha kho so n' eva tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ,
mn22:11.17: evam-eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacce kulaputtā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti . . .
mn22:12.1: Tasmātiha bhikkhave yassa me bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājāneyyātha tathā naṃ dhāreyyātha,
mn22:12.2: yassa ca pana me bhāsitassa atthaṃ na ājāneyyātha ahaṃ vo tattha paṭipucchitabbo ye vā pan' assu viyattā bhikkhū.
mn22:13.1: Kullūpamaṃ vo bhikkhave dhammaṃ desissāmi nittharaṇatthāya no gahaṇatthāya,
mn22:13.3: Evam-bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn22:13.6: so passeyya mahantaṃ udakaṇṇavaṃ, oriman-tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ pāriman-tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ,
mn22:13.7: na cāssa nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā apārā pāraṃ gamanāya;
mn22:13.8: tassa evamassa: \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn22:13.9: Ayaṃ kho mahā udakaṇṇavo, orimañ-ca tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ pāriman-tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ,
mn22:13.10: na-tthi ca nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā apārā pāraṃ gamanāya,
mn22:13.11: yan-nūnāhaṃ tiṇa-kaṭṭha-sākhā-palāsaṃ saṅkaḍḍhitvā kullaṃ bandhitvā taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttareyyan-ti.
mn22:13.12: Atha kho so bhikkhave puriso tiṇa-kaṭṭha-sākhā-palāsaṃ saṅkaḍḍhitvā kullaṃ bandhitvā taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttareyya;
mn22:13.15: imāhaṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttiṇṇo,
mn22:13.16: yan-nūnāhaṃ imaṃ kullaṃ sīse vā āropetvā khandhe vā uccāretvā yenakāmaṃ pakkameyyan-ti.
mn22:13.18: api nu so puriso evaṃkārī tasmiṃ kulle kiccakārī assāti. --
mn22:13.20: Kathaṃkārī ca so bhikkhave puriso tasmiṃ kulle kiccakārī assa:
mn22:13.21: Idha bhikkhave tassa purisassa tiṇṇassa pāraṅgatassa evam-assa:
mn22:13.23: imāhaṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttiṇṇo,
mn22:13.24: yan-nūnāhaṃ imaṃ kullaṃ thale vā ussādetvā udake vā upalāpetvā yenakāmaṃ pakkameyyan-ti.
mn22:13.25: Evaṃkārī kho so bhikkhave puriso tasmiṃ kulle kiccakārī assa.
mn22:13.26: Evam-eva kho bhikkhave kullūpamo mayā dhammo desito nittharaṇatthāya no gahaṇatthāya.
mn22:14.1: Kullūpamaṃ vo bhikkhave ājānantehi dhammā pi vo pahātabbā, pag-eva adhammā.
mn22:15.3: Idha bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto,
mn22:15.4: rūpaṃ: etaṃ mama, eso 'ham-asmi, eso me attā ti samanupassati,
mn22:15.8: yam-p' idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tam-pi. etaṃ mama . . . ti samanupassati,
mn22:15.10: so loko so aṭṭā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ sassatisamaṃ tath' eva ṭhassāmīti,
mn22:15.11: tam-pi: etaṃ mama, eso 'ham-asmi, eso me attā ti samanupassati.
mn22:16.1: Sutavā ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto, sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto,
mn22:16.2: rūpaṃ: n' etaṃ mama, n' eso 'ham-asmi, na me^so attā ti samanupassati,
mn22:16.3: vedanaṃ: n' etaṃ mama . . . ti samanupassati,
mn22:16.4: saññaṃ: n' etaṃ mama . . . ti samanupassati,
mn22:16.5: saṅkhāre: n' etaṃ mama . . . ti samanupassati,
mn22:16.6: yam-p' idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tam-pi: n' etaṃ mama . . . ti samanupassati,
mn22:16.8: so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath' eva ṭhassāmīti,
mn22:16.9: tam-pi: n' etaṃ mama, n' eso 'ham-asmi, na me^so attā ti samanupassati.
mn22:17.1: So evaṃ samanupassanto asati na paritassatīti.
mn22:18.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn22:18.2: Siyā nu kho bhante bahiddhā asati paritassanā ti. --
mn22:18.5: Ahū vata me, taṃ vata me na-tthi,
mn22:18.6: siyā vata me, taṃ vatāhaṃ na labhāmīti.
mn22:18.7: So socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn22:18.8: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu bahiddhā asati paritassanā hotīti. --
mn22:19.1: Siyā pana bhante bahiddhā asati aparitassanā ti. --
mn22:19.3: Idha bhikkhu ekaccassa na evaṃ hoti:
mn22:19.4: Ahū vata me, taṃ vata me na-tthi,
mn22:19.5: siyā vata me, taṃ vatāhaṃ na labhāmīti.
mn22:19.6: So na socati na kilamati na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn22:19.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu bahiddhā asati aparitassanā hotīti. --
mn22:20.1: Siyā nu kho bhante ajjhattaṃ asati paritassanā ti. --
mn22:20.3: Idha bhikkhu ekaccassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti:
mn22:20.4: So loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath' eva ṭhassāmīti.
mn22:20.5: So suṇāti Tathāgatassa vā Tathāgatasāvakassa vā sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānādhiṭṭhāna-pariyuṭṭhānābhinivesānusayānaṃ samugghātāya sabbasaṅkhārasamathāya sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggāya taṇhakkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammaṃ desentassa.
mn22:20.6: Tassa evaṃ hoti: \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn22:20.7: Ucchijjissāmi nāma su, vinassissāmi nāma su, na su nāma bhavissāmīti.
mn22:20.8: So socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn22:20.9: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ asati paritassanā hotīti. --
mn22:21.1: Siyā pana bhante ajjhattaṃ asati aparitassanā ti. --
mn22:21.3: Idha bhikkhu ekaccassa na evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti:
mn22:21.4: So loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath' eva ṭhassāmīti.
mn22:21.5: So suṇāti Tathāgatassa vā Tathāgatasāvakassa vā sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānādhiṭṭhāna-pariyuṭṭhānābhinivesānusayānaṃ samugghātāya sabbasaṅkhārasamathāya sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggāya taṇhakkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammaṃ desentassa.
mn22:21.7: Ucchijjissāmi nāma su, vinassissāmi nāma su, na su nāma bhavissāmīti.
mn22:21.8: So na socati na kilamati na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn22:21.9: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ asati aparitassanā hoti.
mn22:22.1: Taṃ bhikkhave pariggahaṃ parigaṇheyyātha yvāssa pariggaho nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath' eva tiṭṭheyya.
mn22:22.2: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave taṃ pariggahaṃ yvāssa pariggaho . . . tath' eva tiṭṭheyyāti. --
mn22:22.5: aham-pi kho taṃ bhikkhave pariggahaṃ na samanupassāmi yvāssa pariggaho nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath' eva tiṭṭheyya.

mn22:28.1: Evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃ nibbindati, vedanāya nibbindati, saññāya nibbindati, saṅkhāresu nibbindati, viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindati;

mn22:29.2: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn22:30.1: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho iti pi, saṅkiṇṇaparikho iti pi, abbūḷhesiko iti pi, niraggaḷo iti pi, ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto iti pi.
mn22:31.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
mn22:31.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho hoti.
mn22:32.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno ponobhaviko jātisaṃsāro pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
mn22:32.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saṅkiṇṇaparikho hoti.
mn22:33.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
mn22:33.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu abbūḷhesiko hoti.
mn22:34.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno pañc' orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pahīnāni honti ucchinnamūlāni tālāvatthukatāni anabhāvakatāni āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāni.
mn22:34.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu niraggaḷo hoti.

mn22:36.1: Evaṃ vimuttacittaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ sa-Indā devā sa-Brahmakā sa-Pajāpatikā anvesaṃ nādhigacchanti:
mn22:36.4: Diṭṭhe vāhaṃ bhikkhave dhamme tathāgataṃ ananuvejjo ti vadāmi.
mn22:37.1: Evaṃvādiṃ kho maṃ bhikkhave evamakkhāyiṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti:
mn22:37.2: Venayiko samaṇo Gotamo, sato sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññāpetīti.
mn22:37.3: Yathā vāhaṃ bhikkhave na, yathā cāhaṃ na vadāmi, tathā maṃ te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti:
mn22:37.4: Venayiko samaṇo Gotamo, sato sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññāpetīti.
mn22:37.5: Pubbe cāhaṃ bhikkhave etarahi ca dukkhañ-c' eva paññāpemi dukkhassa ca nirodhaṃ.
mn22:37.6: Tatra ce bhikkhave pare Tathāgataṃ akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti, tatra bhikkhave Tathāgatassa na hoti āghāto na appaccayo na cetaso anabhiraddhi.
mn22:38.1: Tatra ce bhikkhave pare Tathāgataṃ sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti, tatra bhikkhave Tathāgatassa na hoti ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso ubbillāvitattaṃ.
mn22:38.2: Tatra ce bhikkhave pare Tathāgataṃ sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti, tatra bhikkhave Tathāgatassa evaṃ hoti:
mn22:38.3: Yaṃ kho idaṃ pubbe pariññātaṃ tattha me evarūpā kārā karīyantīti.
mn22:39.1: Tasmātiha bhikkhave tumhe ce pi pare akkoseyyuṃ paribhāseyyuṃ roseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi na āghāto na appaccayo na cetaso anabhiraddhi karaṇīyā.
mn22:39.2: Tasmātiha bhikkhave tumhe ce pi pare sakkareyyuṃ garukareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi na ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso ubbillāvitattaṃ karaṇīyaṃ.
mn22:39.3: Tasmātiha bhikkhave tumhe ce pi pare sakkareyyuṃ garukareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyuṃ, tatra tumhākaṃ evam-assa:
mn22:39.4: Yaṃ kho idaṃ pubbe pariññātaṃ tattha no evarūpā kārā karīyantīti.
